questions.title: Share of homes in England rented from the local council
questions.unitLabel: % of dwellings rented from local authorities
questions.hint: Postwar slum clearance and council estates, then the 1980 Right to Buy, stock transfers to housing associations and very little new council building.
questions.explanation: It fell to 6.1% in 2025, from 28.2% in 1970. Councils were England’s great landlords after the war, with about 29% of homes in the late 1970s. The 1980 Right to Buy let tenants buy their homes at big discounts, and councils handed estates to housing associations and built little. Homes moved to housing associations no longer count here.

source.attribution: UK Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

questions.title: Share of Norwegian babies born to unmarried parents
questions.hint: Shotgun weddings, the post-war marriage boom, the pill, and couples who simply stopped bothering with a wedding before children.
questions.explanation: It rose to 61.6% in 2025, from 4.6% in 1965. Cohabitation took over from marriage: most of these babies are now born to couples living together, not to single mothers.

questions.title: Meat available per person in Germany
questions.hint: People usually eat more meat as they get richer, though culture and religion matter too.
questions.explanation: It went from 65 kg in 1963 to a high of 100 kg in 1988, then ended at 71 kg in 2023.

questions.title: Share of electricity from nuclear power in France
questions.hint: France launched a large state-led reactor programme after the 1973 oil crisis.
questions.explanation: It fell to 65% in 2023, from 77% in 1995.

questions.title: Electoral democracy score of Spain
questions.explanation: It went from 0.55 in 1935 to a low of 0.07 in 1941, then ended at 0.87 in 2019.
